jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst
, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

Some of the Problems You'll Solve:

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

How You'll Make an Impact:

📊 Build confidence in business decisions by designing analyses and communicating insights that help teams understand what is working – and what isn't.

📈 Turn data into strategic direction by uncovering trends, identifying opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations.

📉 Create visibility into organizational performance through dashboards, reporting, and metrics that stakeholders rely on every day.

🤝 Partner with cross-functional teams to frame business problems, evaluate options, and ensure decisions are supported by data.

🎯 Develop meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that enable teams to consistently measure success and track progress over time.

🔍 Identify opportunities to improve business processes, customer experiences, and operational efficiency through thoughtful analysis.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:

🧩 Use data to drive decisions.

You have a track record of solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and influencing decisions with data.

📊 Have strong analytical fundamentals.

SQL is a core part of your toolkit, and you're comfortable working with large datasets to uncover meaningful insights.

📈 Think beyond reporting.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

💬 Communicate with clarity.

You can explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and help stakeholders make informed decisions.

🤝 Enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

You're comfortable starting with a business question—not a predefined report—and determining what data, analyses, or metrics are needed to answer it.

🔄 Adapt quickly to new tools and technologies.

You enjoy learning new platforms and approaches and focus on solving problems rather than relying on a specific technology stack.

🛠 Bring experience with modern analytics tools.

Experience with SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms is a plus, but not required. Great analysts learn new tools. Great critical thinking is harder to teach.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Business Data Analyst owns the analytical layer between data infrastructure and decision-making — turning warehouse data into dashboards, metrics, and insights that drive product, growth, and operations decisions. The role works with dbt models, SQL-first transformations, and BI tooling in a data environment built for scale.

This is a high-visibility position: the analyst partners directly with product managers, finance, and engineering leadership, and the quality of their work shapes how the business measures itself. The team values rigorous methodology over quick answers.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain executive and operational dashboards in Looker or Tableau, serving stakeholders across product, marketing, and finance
Develop and document dbt models and semantic layers, owning metric definitions end-to-end from raw events to governed business metrics
Run deep-dive analyses on user behavior, retention, funnel conversion, and unit economics using SQL and Python
Partner with product managers to define success metrics, design A/B test frameworks, and interpret experiment results with statistical rigor
Identify data quality issues at the source — writing dbt tests and monitoring checks to catch anomalies before they reach stakeholders
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical frameworks, communicating findings through clear narratives and actionable recommendations
Contribute to self-serve analytics enablement: build data documentation, train stakeholders, and reduce ad-hoc request load over time

What We Are Looking For

3–6 years of experience in business analytics, data analytics, or analytics engineering at a product-driven technology company
Expert-level SQL — complex window functions, CTEs, query optimization — demonstrated daily in real workflows
Hands-on experience with a modern data stack: Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, dbt, and at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or Power BI)
Working proficiency in Python or R for analysis, including pandas and statistical libraries
Strong foundation in statistics and experimentation: hypothesis testing, significance, sample sizing, and A/B test interpretation
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, computer science, engineering) or equivalent practical experience
Bonus: experience with event-level analytics tools (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel), exposure to data cataloging or semantic layer tools (Cube, Atlan), and a track record of automating recurring reporting with Airflow or similar orchestrators

jobs.description:
Team Name

Job Title:

Marketing Data Analyst | Irvine, CA or Remote

Requisition ID

R028310

Job Description

At Blizzard Entertainment, we don't just publish games; we help them thrive. Our games are at the heart of our players' lives, and our mission is to ensure they are engaging, rewarding, and always improving. The Marketing Analytics team plays a vital role in achieving this by combining technical expertise with business insights to optimize marketing strategies and ensure data-driven decision-making.

We are seeking a Marketing Data Analyst to support content performance tracking, reporting, and insights development for multiple social content and channel optimization initiatives. This role will report directly to the Audience Development Manager and support the advocacy of established KPIs in shaping channel strategy insights, articulating platform best practices and driving regular reporting to key stakeholders. In this role you will contribute directly to elevating our insights across earned, owned and user-generated social content for multiple franchises. If you have a passion for turning data into actionable strategies and enjoy collaborating across disciplines, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is anticipated to be a hybrid work position, with some work on-site and some work-from-home. The potential home studio for this role is Irvine, CA. However, we understand each person’s circumstances may be unique and will work with you to explore other possible options, including remote work arrangements.

Responsibilities

Own focused reporting across major release roadmap moments
Regularly construct and maintain advanced Boolean topic queries
Design, build and maintain social data dashboards
Ensure program KPIs are integrated in reporting outputs and performance goals are socialized across franchise groups
Partner with analyst team to ensure overall deliverable quality and reporting is rooted in tangible, quantitative insights
Establish and maintain knowledge of current franchise communities
Establish and maintain knowledge of content cycles (patches, expansions, etc.)

Minimum Requirements

3+ years’ data analysis experience in media planning, social media management and/or digital marketing analytics/research
Demonstrated experience in Project Management
Deep understanding of current social / video platform landscape and content archetypes
Demonstrated experience in the use of tools like Sprinklr, native social analytics platforms, and other UGC data-focused platforms (Ex. Stream Hatchet, Tubular)
Experience building interactive dashboards with at least one visualization tool (Ex.Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)
Experience driving social listening programs, developing involved topic queries and comprehensive analysis (Ex. landscape, competitor, campaign)
Strong analytical, written and verbal presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and craft informed recommendations
Proficient in Microsoft/Google productivity suites (Ex. Excel/Sheets, Powerpoint/Slides)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the gaming industry or working with marketing teams in a digital-first environment
Education / background in marketing, data analytics or paid media
Data-science / statistics experience
Working knowledge of SQL (BigQuery a plus)
Love for gaming and knowledge of Blizzard franchises in particular strongly preferred

Your Platform

Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, and StarCraft®, Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. (www.blizzard.com), a division of Activision Blizzard, which was acquired by Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), is a premier developer and publisher of entertainment experiences. Blizzard Entertainment has created some of the industry’s most critically acclaimed and genre-defining games over the last 30 years, with a track record that includes multiple Game of the Year awards. Blizzard Entertainment engages tens of millions of players around the world with titles available on PC via Battle.net®, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android.

Our World

Activision Blizzard, Inc., is one of the world's largest and most successful interactive entertainment companies and is at the intersection of media, technology and entertainment. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, World of Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, Candy Crush™ and Bubble Witch™. Our combined entertainment network delights hundreds of millions of monthly active users in 196 countries, making us the largest gaming network on the planet!

Our ability to build immersive and innovative worlds is only enhanced by diverse teams working in an inclusive environment. We aspire to have a culture where everyone can thrive in order to connect and engage the world through epic entertainment. We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered!

The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

Rewards

Requirements

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/.

In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $35.03 - $64.80 Hourly. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed. While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.
